mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite inflation signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the unemployment rise, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand decline, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the supply increase, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the overheating signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances despite the labor market strength, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing market decline, or HOUST decline > 10% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the recession signal, or the interaction of low GDP growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
